messages.subject: Fleet change: original phone pane owner-resumed; main HTTP stays independent
messages.body: The 22:18 UTC fleet change is the SAME retained phone terminal term_1f27be31-0284-4366-bb91-30fe538cd30e / ctx_104db5d889d2 / task_e35b809903c1 becoming live; its old failed dispatch outcome remains history, and no new worker or ownership adoption was performed. One exact worker-read shows an explicit owner resume of that phone setup lane and a reported POCO USB-controller-access blocker, with no native pilot; the worker already sent its blocker report to this Run and is seeking the existing Personal controller authority in its own lane. This monitor has not verified a USB grant or any missing-permission fix; retain that lane's own precise action request, never release/stop the retained terminal, and keep Root's healthy V2296 main HTTP collection independent of phone readiness.
